payload.title: A second, very different newsroom runs on the same code (Humorus)
payload.description:
Humorus is a monorepo of political-satire publications on Papyrus, deployed as ONE deployment in a dedicated account in another AWS organisation. It exists to force three things: a neutral default front end with example themes, an early two-site deployment, and newsroom policy that is data. Rule on the Humorus side: improve Papyrus, never work around it.

Decisions from Ryan, 2026-11-11: a scaffold writes editable defaults and the site owns them afterwards (this reverses add-only agent prompts); the neutral theme is factored out of Machines on Machines; shared services run in the deployment's own account; satire is labelled for agents.

Related: PPY-25ffa3 (standard front end and multi-tenant service), PPY-2a2a8a (guidelines as data), PPY-959e41 (story automation).
